name: ML Learning Paradigms
description: Classify each algorithm into its learning paradigm: supervised, unsupervised, or reinforcement.

facets.label: Paradigm
facets.prompt: Which learning paradigm does {entity} belong to?

explain.paradigm: K-Means groups unlabeled data into clusters, so it is unsupervised.
Linear Regression fits labeled input-output pairs, so it is supervised.
Q-Learning learns action values from rewards, the core of reinforcement learning.
PCA reduces dimensionality without labels, so it is unsupervised.
Random Forest is an ensemble of decision trees trained on labeled data.

entities.entity: DBSCAN (Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise)

explain.paradigm: DBSCAN clusters points by density without labels, so it is unsupervised.
SVM learns a decision boundary from labeled examples, so it is supervised.
Autoencoders learn to reconstruct their input without labels, so they are unsupervised.
